182732.overview: Staroc is a horizontally scrolling shoot-'em-up. Players control a spaceship that can move up and down and can fire lasers. The players spaceship flies through an asteroid belt and then over hostile territory and has to contend with several flying enemies as well as missiles that are launched from the ground surface. Shooting down enemies earns the player points. The player starts the game with three spaceships. Once they are all lost, the game ends. The player can then enter their name on a high score list if their score is high enough to qualify.
